course_name_original: Sistemas de gestion de la calidad (1817)

learning_outcomes.text: Use specialized language and quality concepts appropriately in various areas of business management and identify the principles of total quality philosophy.
Properly apply the different quality management tools and techniques.
Design process maps, set management indicators, and document processes.
Understand the basic principles and requirements of the ISO 9000 standard.
Understand the fundamental concepts of excellence, as well as the criteria of the EFQM model.
Understand the different management excellence models.

teaching_methods: Case study: Learning acquisition through the analysis of real or simulated cases, in order to interpret and solve them, training various alternative solution procedures.
Expository/Lecture: Transmit knowledge and activate cognitive processes in the student, involving their participation.
Exercise and problem solving: Practice, rehearse and put previous knowledge into practice through routine repetition.
assessment_rules: Two modalities are available for evaluation: Modality A and Modality B (Continuous Evaluation). For Modality A, the final grade consists of a written multiple-choice test (50%) and an individual project (50%). For Modality B, which requires 50% class attendance, the grade is composed of a written multiple-choice test (20%), an individual project (60%), and class attendance and participation (20%). In both modalities, the multiple-choice test deducts 1 correct answer for every 4 incorrect answers.
